speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with fever and abdominal tenderness after giving birth; have you noticed any foul-smelling vaginal discharge or unusual bleeding?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible Urinary Tract Infection. The combination of fever, uterine tenderness, and foul-smelling discharge after a prolonged labor strongly suggests endometritis, while decreased bowel sounds and urinary frequency raise concern for a concurrent UTI or ileus.
